slot_scores.name: idle_time_no_cost
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether idle machine or craftsman time incurs a cost, and did not explicitly mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

slot_scores.name: fractional_batches_allowed
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the production quantities of X and Y be whole batches (integers), or can they be fractional?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether production quantities must be integer or can be fractional, matching the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: all_batches_sold
slot_scores.evidence_quote: There is no upper limit on demand for either product, so all produced batches are sold.
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask a direct question about whether all batches are sold or whether demand constraints exist, but it explicitly marked the no-demand/all-sold condition as an assumption needing correction.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Idle machine and craftsman time incurs no cost; only actual time used is charged.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle-time cost and did not explicitly flag this as an assumption needing confirmation, yet used it in the profit calculation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped after resolving the only directly asked hidden slot and explicitly flagging the all-sold assumption; the remaining unresolved hidden slot is P2 only, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent asked about fractional batches and explicitly flagged the all-sold/no-demand assumption, but missed the idle-time cost clarification and silently assumed idle time is free. Overall interaction quality is adequate for a P2-only hidden-slot set.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
